key_recovery.title: Recover missing gateway key
key_recovery.description: A recovery method is available for this confirmed gateway build. Home Assistant suggests {callback_address}. Use a numeric private IPv4 address that the gateway can reach. Recovery starts a temporary callback listener on a port chosen by Home Assistant; allow the gateway to reach this Home Assistant host on that port. This reads one diagnostic file and does not enable Telnet or alter account passwords. Some firmware removes an existing temporary /tmp/log.tar.gz archive after the upload. Recovery can take up to 90 seconds. To use the manual path, enter an existing 16-character key instead.

key_recovery_confirm.title: Confirm existing gateway setup
key_recovery_confirm.description: The recovered key is held in memory and has not been saved yet. Continuing calls this integration's existing gateway setup check. That check may clear the gateway root password and enable Telnet. Proceed only if you accept those actions.
